termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.intro: This document sets out the terms for using the Nafas platform — an observability and telemetry service provided by Aban. By creating an account or using the service, you agree to these terms. If you act on behalf of an organization, you confirm you have authority to accept these terms for it.

sections.heading: 1. Description of the Service
sections.body: Nafas is a multi-tenant observability and telemetry platform that collects, stores, and displays logs, metrics, traces, and profiles from your infrastructure and software. The service is offered in two models: hosted (SaaS) on our own infrastructure, or a dedicated install (On-Premise) on your own infrastructure. These terms apply equally to both models unless a section explicitly says otherwise.

sections.heading: 2. Your Account
sections.body: You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide when registering, and for keeping your password and access tokens confidential. You are responsible for any activity carried out under your account, or under any account belonging to your organization. You must notify us immediately if you become aware of any unauthorized access.

sections.heading: 3. Acceptable Use
sections.body: Using the service for any unlawful purpose, submitting data that infringes a third party's rights, attempting unauthorized access to our infrastructure or to other tenants, circumventing rate limits, or reverse-engineering proprietary parts of the platform is prohibited. Violating this section may result in immediate suspension or termination of access.

sections.heading: 4. Your Data
sections.body: Ownership of the data you send to Nafas through your own instrumentation (logs, metrics, traces) always remains yours. By sending this data, you grant us a limited, non-exclusive license to process, store, and display it solely to provide, maintain, and improve the service. We do not use this data for any other purpose, such as selling it to a third party.

sections.heading: 5. Subscription, Billing, and Wallet
sections.body: Payments are processed through the ZarinPal payment gateway. Depending on your chosen plan, your subscription may renew automatically unless cancelled before the end of the billing period. Wallet top-ups and deductions are non-refundable except at our discretion or where required by law. Late payment may result in temporary suspension of service.

sections.heading: 6. Service Availability
sections.body: We aim to provide the service with the highest practical level of reliability, but — except under a separate, signed Service Level Agreement (SLA) — no guarantee of uninterrupted availability is made. Planned maintenance is communicated in advance whenever possible.

sections.heading: 7. Intellectual Property
sections.body: The Nafas platform, its brand, interface design, and source code (excluding your data) belong to Aban. Nothing in these terms transfers any ownership or license beyond ordinary use of the service to you.

sections.heading: 8. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: The service is provided "as is." To the extent permitted by law, Aban is not liable for indirect or consequential damages, or for data loss caused by third-party system failures, internet outages, or misconfiguration on your own end. Our total liability in any case will not exceed the total fees you paid in the preceding three months.

sections.heading: 9. Suspension and Termination
sections.body: We may suspend or terminate your access, temporarily or permanently, if you violate these terms, fail to pay, or use the service in a way that harms our infrastructure or other tenants. You may also stop using the service at any time by requesting account deactivation.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Material changes will be communicated by email or an in-platform notice. Continuing to use the service after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

sections.heading: 11. Governing Law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Islamic Republic of Iran. Any dispute, if not resolved through negotiation, will be subject to the competent courts of Iran.

sections.heading: 12. Contact Us
sections.body: For any questions about these terms, you can reach us through the support email address published on the platform.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This policy explains what information Aban, the provider of the Nafas platform, collects, how it is used, and what rights you have over your own data.

sections.heading: 1. What We Collect
sections.body: Account information (email, hashed password), session information (IP address, user agent, sign-in/sign-out times, used for security and for the "recent activity" list in account settings), billing information (via the ZarinPal payment gateway), and telemetry data (logs, metrics, traces) that you send to the platform through your own instrumentation.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use This Information
sections.body: This information is used solely to provide and maintain the service, authenticate you and prevent unauthorized access (such as throttling failed sign-in attempts), process payments, and communicate with you about your account or the service.

sections.heading: 3. Cookies and Local Storage
sections.body: A secure cookie is used to keep your sign-in session active. Display preferences (language, text direction, light/dark theme) are stored in your browser's local storage and are never sent to our servers.

sections.heading: 4. Third-Party Sign-In (Google, Microsoft, Apple, GitHub)
sections.body: If you sign in through one of these providers, your identity is verified directly and cryptographically with that provider. The only information we receive and store from this verification is your email address, display name, and a one-way, non-reversible provider identifier — we never have access to your password or any other account information held by that provider.

sections.heading: 5. Sharing Information
sections.body: Billing information is shared with ZarinPal to process payments. Your data may be stored on the infrastructure of the hosting providers we use to run the service. We never sell your information to a third party for advertising purposes.

sections.heading: 6. Data Security
sections.body: All communication with the platform is encrypted over HTTPS. Passwords are stored hashed, access to internal infrastructure is restricted and controlled, and sensitive configuration values are never kept in public source code.

sections.heading: 7. Data Retention
sections.body: Account information is kept for as long as your account remains active. Telemetry data is retained according to the retention period defined by your subscription plan and is automatically deleted afterward. Following an account deletion request, your personal information is deleted or anonymized within a reasonable period, except where the law requires longer retention.

sections.heading: 8. Your Rights
sections.body: You can request access to your account information, correct it, or delete your account at any time from the settings section. For requests that cannot be completed through the platform itself, you can contact support directly.

sections.heading: 9. Children's Privacy
sections.body: The Nafas service is not designed for use by individuals under the age of 18, and we do not knowingly collect information from children.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: This policy may be updated from time to time. Material changes will be communicated by email or an in-platform notice.

sections.heading: 11. Contact Us
sections.body: For any questions about this policy or your information, you can reach us through the support email address published on the platform.
